description.value: Banter Ice Cream is a Fraser Valley-founded handmade ice cream shop located in Abbotsford's Jubilee Park, housed in the old library building with adjacent outdoor green space. Founded by Laura and Zach after a trip to the Gulf Islands, the shop rotates four new seasonal flavours each month using locally sourced ingredients from Fraser Valley farmers and artisans. The park setting with outdoor space makes it a natural rest stop, and the shop encourages visitors to bring picnics and lawn games.

address.value: 33660 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC V2S 2B9

enrichment_extras.notes: The shop is described as 'a bit tricky to find' — entrance is on the south side of the old library building, with parking on Pauline Street. Pets not allowed indoors per Fraser Health regulations but welcome in outdoor areas.
